items.name: Barwon Cube for the Kids 2021

venue.name: Barwon Heads Primary School
venue.address: 3A Golf Links Rd, Barwon Heads VIC 3227

items.information: ![](https://www.kidsplus.org.au/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/logo_kidsplus_sticky.png) This competition will be raising funds for the [Kids Plus Foundation ](https://www.kidsplus.org.au/) 50% of your registration fee will be donated to the Foundation to support treatment and interventions for babies, children and young people with cerebral palsy and similar neurological conditions. ![](https://i.imgur.com/ZIPeEfV.png) **Important notes:** Please take the time to read the FAQ tab, even if you have previously competed. To ensure this is a COVID-safe environment, things will be done differently and there will be additional conditions in place. Please note there is a **strict** density limit at the venue and competitors may only bring **ONE** guest. If you feel sick, stay at home. If you are exhibiting cold or flu-like symptoms consistent with COVID-19, you will not be permitted in the venue. We are not responsible for any illness you may contract from the competition. **Contact us** We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)! [Speedcubing Australia Website](https://speedcubing.org.au)

items.name: Twisty Taranaki 2021

venue.name: [Pukekura Function Centre] (http://www.pukekurafunctions.co.nz/)
venue.address: Rogan Street, Welbourn, New Plymouth, 4310, New Zealand
venue.details: La Mer Lounge, inside the Pukekura Function Centre located at the New Plymouth Raceway

items.information: Twisty Taranaki 2021 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.
